messages:
maya: FYI nightly audit golden resample failed — validator raised missing fields after the RBAC keystore rewrap. CI blocked.

 audit-ci: [ci] nightly/audit-golden-resample #1176 failed (7 failing tests). See logs: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/1176 :warning:

 jordan: ACK. which test is tripping? paste the assertion?

 maya: failing test `tests/audit/golden_events/test_actor_identity.py::test_actor_presence`

 maya: stack (trimmed):
 ```
 E AssertionError: Missing required key: actor.email
 E Received: {"actor": {"id": "svc-123", "service_account": true}}
 E Expected: {"actor": {"id": "svc-123", "email": "svc@org.redwood"}}
 ```

 lee: :eyes: that aligns with the keystore rewrap change — we started redacting PII for service accounts so email might be intentionally removed during rewrap. Could be golden fixtures were regenerated from the new export.

 andrea: We need a hermetic repro to decide whether to change fixtures or validator. Any chance the resample ran against a different keystore policy?

 jordan: repro steps I used locally:
 ```
 git checkout fixtures/golden/audit-events
 python -m pytest tests/audit/golden_events/test_actor_identity.py -q
 ```
 Then resample:
 ```
 PYTHONPATH=. python scripts/generate_golden.py --resample --collection audit-events
 ```
 Resample reproduced the failure — validator enforces actor.email currently.

 sam: short-term mitigation: revert the resample commit in CI and mark the nightly job as flaky until we agree on the contract. Long-term: two options — (A) make validator accept missing actor.email when actor.service_account==true, or (B) change keystore rewrap to retain email for exported golden samples.

 maya: We cannot silently change customer-facing audit schema. Customers rely on actor.identifiers. Any compatibility change needs a documented migration and opt-in.

 lee: Proposal: update the JSON schema validator to treat `actor.email` as optional when `actor.service_account` is true, and add an integration test that accepts both shapes. Publish a migration note and timeline. This buys time while security decides whether email should be preserved in rewrap exports.

 andrea: Also add a CI safeguard: `scripts/generate_golden.py` should fail unless a `GOLDEN_CHANGELOG` env var or `--changelog` flag is provided. That prevents accidental resamples without tracked rationale.

 jordan: I'll open a PR with two ordered commits: (1) validator: conditional optional field + unit/integration tests, (2) generator/CI: require changelog env var and fail otherwise. Will include a changelog template.

 jordan: PR: https://gh.redwood.example/redwood/inference/pull/4521 — includes tests and a changelog skeleton. :thumbsup:

 ops-bot: Created issue #1337: audit-event-contract/service-account-redaction-policy. Assigned to @lee and @andrea.

 sam: After the PR merges, schedule a targeted canary run against a subset of customers (two large tenants) and monitor alerting for audit ingestion errors. Notify SRE on-call and CS for customer communication.

 maya: agreed. please drop any other golden failures into this thread so we can triage together. :shipit:
